questions.question: Which conversion occurs primarily in an electric generator?
choices: Mechanical energy to electrical energy
Electrical energy to chemical energy
Light energy to gravitational energy
Thermal energy to nuclear energy

questions.question: Which conversion occurs primarily in an electric motor?
choices: Mechanical energy to nuclear energy
Electrical energy to mechanical energy
Chemical energy to light only
Gravitational energy to chemical energy

questions.question: Which device directly converts light energy into electrical energy?
choices: Steam turbine
Rechargeable battery while charging
Photovoltaic cell
Gasoline engine

questions.question: What is useful efficiency of an energy converter?
choices: Input energy divided by time only
Total mass divided by volume
Output temperature divided by input temperature
Useful output energy divided by input energy

questions.question: What powers a hydroelectric turbine directly?
choices: Energy transferred from moving water
Chemical energy released by burning water
Electrical energy supplied from the river to the turbine directly
Heat from sunlight reaching the turbine blades directly

questions.question: What form of energy is stored in a charged battery?
choices: Only sound energy
Chemical energy
Only gravitational energy
Nuclear energy from fusion

questions.question: What is a common nonuseful output of real energy conversions?
choices: Newly created massless matter
Disappearing electric charge
Thermal energy spread into the surroundings
Destroyed atomic nuclei in every device

questions.question: Why can an energy conversion be less than 100% useful without violating conservation?
choices: Some input energy is destroyed inside the converter
Energy conservation applies only to perfectly efficient devices
Input energy must be calculated from useful output alone
Some energy goes into outputs other than the intended one

questions.question: In a steam power plant, what does steam do to a turbine?
choices: Transfers energy that turns the turbine
Creates electrical current without turbine or generator motion
Converts the fuel directly into stored battery energy
Condenses the fuel without transferring mechanical energy

questions.question: Why does friction lower the useful mechanical output of a machine?
choices: It removes energy from the total energy balance
It transfers some energy into heating
It increases all of the energy available for useful work
It transfers every input into gravitational potential energy

questions.question: How does a fuel cell differ from a battery during sustained operation?
choices: It has no chemical reactions while delivering electricity
It stores all required reactants inside like a sealed battery
It receives reactants from outside to continue supplying energy
It converts fuel only by combustion and a turbine

questions.question: What happens when a rechargeable battery is charged?
choices: Chemical energy is released entirely as useful mechanical work
All electric charge remains stored as free electrons without chemical change
The same reactions proceed only in the discharge direction
Electrical energy is stored through chemical changes

questions.question: Why are multiple conversion stages relevant to overall efficiency?
choices: Losses at each stage reduce the final useful fraction
Stage efficiencies can be added to find overall efficiency
Later stages automatically recover every earlier loss
Only the last stage affects useful final output

questions.question: What is the main distinction between power and energy in a generating system?
choices: Power is the total energy stored forever
Power is the rate of energy transfer
Energy is measured only in watts
Energy and power always have identical units

questions.question: Why can insulation improve an energy system's useful performance?
choices: It increases the energy input without consuming fuel
It guarantees 100% useful conversion
It reduces unwanted thermal energy transfer
It stops all energy transfer inside the system
